qualification-identifiers:
Qualification project identifier settings: identifiers are opaque strings — trim surrounding whitespace only, preserving leading zeros and case (e.g. "000417" and "AC-019"). Applies to integration-qualification work such as id_format.py in issue trial-1ax, which supplied these settings.

```json
{"project": "qualification", "identifiers": {"kind": "opaque-string", "trim": true}, "examples": ["000417", "AC-019"]}
```
